limitations: Matched maximum forward-ray budgets; actual adaptive calls can be lower
Forward-reference agreement is numerical cross-sampling, not an external optical model validation
Area and classification are sample-based; unresolved bands and unseen sub-cell features are not certified
Memory is a process snapshot, not measured peak; inverse before/after includes atlas and seeded retries
